messages:
dmitri: Heads-up — I just saw a short spike (~45s) of 502/504s hitting ingress in eq-prod us-west. Logs show TLS handshake backoff retries from a subset of client IPs. Creating this follow-up thread to track postmortem actions. TCKT-8219 created.

carla: saw the same. pattern looks like connection resets -> aggressive client retries. recurring around deploy windows the past few months. :eyes:

alice: assigning myself to kernel/conntrack investigation. ACTION: alice -> confirm conntrack exhaustion or NAT port exhaustion. ETA 48h. I'll start with `ss -s` + conntrack stats on the node pool.

ben: will handle the LB side (haproxy/nginx) TLS handshake queuing and SSL session cache. ACTION: ben -> test increasing ssl session cache & handshake backoff values, ETA 24h. will spin a canary.

elaine: i'll update the canary routing policy to avoid the affected AZ for the next 24h while we validate. ACTION: elaine -> create rollback plan and update traffic-steering doc, ETA 6h.

ops-bot: TCKT-8219 created and linked to runbook `ingress-handshake-backoff`. Please attach findings & config diffs.

dmitri: add an alert for handshake backoff rate — recommended: `tls_handshake_backoff_rate > 0.5% over 5m`. who will own alerting/playbook?

carla: i'll own the alerting. ACTION: carla -> create alert + playbook steps (notify #incidents + pager after 2 continuous minutes). ETA 4h.

alice: quick notes on what i'll run: ```conntrack -S ; ss -tan state syn-recv | wc -l ; sudo cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max``` and `nstat | grep TcpExtTCPAbortOnMemory`. i'll upload outputs to TCKT-8219.

ben: i'll post a minimal `haproxy.cfg` diff to test: increase `tune.ssl.default-dh-param`, bump `ssl-session-cache` and add a small client timeout backoff. will canary then rollback if CPU/regressions.

elaine: also saw cross-region fallback churn: some requests from us-east were failing and client side retried to us-west causing extra pressure. ACTION: elaine -> audit fallback routing policy and origin affinity, ETA 48h.

dmitri: recurrence note: link to prior incidents TCKT-4021, TCKT-6205, TCKT-7210 — seems correlated with deploy windows and load spike patterns. please add recurrence tag on TCKT-8219 if you see overlap.

carla: adding `recurrence` label and linking previous tickets now. also will add runbook step to temporarily reroute traffic when backoff spike > threshold.

alice: if conntrack is OK, next step is instrumenting kernel TCP backoff counters and collecting pcap on a sample host for 10 minutes during a repro. will coordinate times.

ben: :thumbsup: will coordinate haproxy canary window with alice's pcap window.

dmitri: summary of owners/ETAs: alice (conntrack + kernel instrumentation) 48h; ben (LB tune & canary) 24h; elaine (routing/fallback audit + rollback plan) 48h; carla (alert + runbook) 4h. i'll send a short summary to infra PM and close this Slack thread — continue updates in TCKT-8219 under `remediation/owner`. check-in async tomorrow COB.

carla: ack :white_check_mark: updating ticket now.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-in in 24h for TCKT-8219.

dmitri: thanks all — please tag any short findings in the ticket rather than here to keep a single source of truth.
